repos_data.description: MCP server for Google Search Console — query search analytics, inspect URLs, find keyword opportunities, track SEO performance. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf.
MCP server for Google Search Console, URL Inspection & Indexing API — full API coverage (13 tools)

Google Search Console MCP server for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and any MCP client. Query clicks, impressions, average position, URL inspection, sitemaps, and eligible indexing workflows. Run locally with npm or self-host on Cloudflare Workers. Google OAuth, no API keys. By digestseo.com.
